what: Give each person on All branches "Who to call, in every branch" a Call and a WhatsApp button
why: Today the only button is Open, which switches the whole app to that branch just to phone one member; an owner calling 20 people across branches switches back and forth 20 times
impact_why: This list exists only to make calls; every call costs a branch switch today
my_view: My view: do it; the number is already on the line, so it is two buttons with no server change.

what: Change the demo gym bar button to "Start my gym free", opening Create my gym, and add the same button on every "This works in your own gym" page
why: Someone trying the demo who likes it is sent to the website (or back to Today), not to the one page that turns them into a gym
impact_why: The demo is the warmest moment a gym owner has; one fewer hop there is the cheapest sign-up win in this area
my_view: My view: do it; keep "Leave the demo" as a small second link for people who only wanted to look.

what: Add "Send on WhatsApp" under the UPI QR: a ready message with the gym UPI ID, the amount and the receipt note
why: A member who is not at the desk cannot scan the QR; WhatsApp sending exists only for payment-company links, so a UPI-only gym (most gyms) has nothing to send
impact_why: Most gyms have a UPI ID and no payment company; fee chasing happens on WhatsApp
my_view: My view: do it; reuse the payment-link WhatsApp button and its message, with the UPI ID in place of the link.

what: Make "Add UPI ID" open the UPI ID box itself, from both Payments and the Pay online box
why: Pay online says "Add your UPI ID in Settings" and opens Payments; Payments says "add it in Gym details" and opens the top of Settings; the owner then hunts for the box: three hops for one field
impact_why: The UPI ID unlocks the QR for every sale; a lost owner never sets it
my_view: My view: do it; jump straight to the UPI field, or let it be typed on Payments.

what: On Payments, show what online payments brought in: "This month: Rs X from N online payments", with the last five
why: The page shows only set-up switches; the owner never sees that connecting a payment company is working for him
impact_why: Seeing the money is what keeps an owner using online payments and telling other owners
my_view: My view: worth it after payments go live; the receipts already carry "Paid online", so the count needs no new store.

what: Look up a visitor from another branch by itself once the 10th digit is typed, so the desk goes type, then Check in
why: Today the desk types the number, taps Find, waits, then taps Check in, at the busiest moment of the door
impact_why: Every cross-branch visit goes through this card
my_view: My view: do it; keep the Find button for slow lines, and keep the hourly lookup limit counting.

what: When a visitor’s plan is for their own branch only, let the owner allow this one visit (or charge a day fee) from the same card
why: The card only says "Ask them to go there, or ask the owner", with nothing the owner can tap; the member is turned away at a branch of the same business
impact_why: A member turned away at a sister branch is a complaint; a day fee is extra money
my_view: My view: ask him first; a one-visit pass needs an owner rule (free, or a set fee) before it is built.

what: Turn "Last refused at the door" into a list of today’s refused members, each with Renew and WhatsApp
why: A member refused by the finger machine is the best renewal moment there is; today the screen shows only a count and the last one, with no button
impact_why: Plan-ended members at the door are ready to pay right then; GymMaster (as known by Jun 2026, not re-checked live) lists denied entries for follow-up
my_view: My view: build it with the entry machine launch, not before; the machine feature is not live yet.

what: Replace "open Help and feedback and write: Move us to Pro" with one "Ask for Pro" button that sends that request
why: An owner who wants to pay more is given typing homework; many will not finish it
impact_why: Every Pro request is revenue; the lock screen is where the owner decides
my_view: My view: do it when the Pro lock is switched on; until then nobody sees these pages.

what: When adding a branch, offer to copy gym timings, the UPI ID and the logo and colours too, not only plans
why: The add sheet copies plans (and the GST number) only; the owner then sets the same things again in the new branch
impact_why: Done once per branch, but it is the first impression of the branch feature
my_view: My view: worth it, as ticks that start on; a branch with a different UPI account is common, so the owner must be able to untick it.

what: Offer automatic monthly fees through the connected payment company (UPI AutoPay mandate): the member approves once, the fee is taken each month and the receipt is made by itself
why: Monthly members are chased every month; Razorpay Subscriptions with UPI AutoPay (as known by Jun 2026, not re-checked live) already does this for gyms on Razorpay
impact_why: Removes the monthly chase for monthly members, and late fees stop slipping
my_view: My view: not yet; first prove live one-off payments and refunds, then pilot with one gym on Razorpay.
